goal: Implement the event bus, HTTP server with middleware chain, health endpoint, config loading, and graceful shutdown. Wire everything in cmd/api/main.go. This is the running application skeleton.

tasks.name: Event bus (sync + async + composite)
tasks.action: Implement internal/common/event — the in-process event bus with sync dispatch, async dispatch, and composite publisher. ~300 lines total. All with tests.
microSteps: Implement event.go: Event interface (EventName() string), Handler type (func(ctx, Event) error), Publisher interface (Publish(ctx, ...Event) error)
Implement bus.go: Bus struct with sync dispatch — Subscribe(eventName, handler), Publish runs handlers sequentially, returns first error
Write bus_test.go: test subscribe + publish, multiple handlers, error propagation, unknown event name
Implement async.go: AsyncBus with goroutine worker pool — Subscribe, Publish enqueues to channel, workers process. Graceful shutdown via Close().
Write async_test.go: test async delivery, handler errors logged not returned, Close() drains queue. Use -race flag.
Implement composite.go: CompositePublisher wrapping sync Bus + async AsyncBus. Publish runs sync first, then async. If sync fails, async is skipped.
Write composite_test.go: test sync-then-async ordering, sync failure blocks async

tasks.name: Config + server + error responses + middleware
tasks.action: Implement config loading (env vars → struct), HTTP server with chi + middleware chain (RequestID, slog, Recovery, CORS, RateLimit), error response helper mapping DomainError → JSON, and health handler.
microSteps: Implement config.go: Config struct (Port, DatabaseURL, JWTSecret, Env), Load() from os.Getenv with defaults
Implement server.go: NewServer(cfg, handler) with http.Server, ListenAndServe(), GracefulShutdown(ctx) with SIGTERM handling
Implement response.go: JSON(w, status, data), Error(w, err) mapping DomainError codes to HTTP status + JSON error body {code, message}
Write response_test.go: test JSON rendering, DomainError → HTTP status mapping, unknown error → 500

Implement middleware.go: RequestID (X-Request-ID header), StructuredLogger (slog with request_id, method, path, duration), Recovery (panic → 500), CORS (configurable origins), RateLimit (x/time/rate, per-IP)
Implement health.go: HealthHandler(db) returning {status: 'ok', uptime: '...', database: 'ok'/'error'} with DB ping
Write health_test.go: test health response format, test with nil DB (database: 'unavailable')

tasks.name: Composition root — cmd/api/main.go wiring
tasks.action: Wire everything together in main.go: load config, connect pgx pool, create event bus, build chi router with middleware + health endpoint, start server with graceful shutdown. Add go.sum by running go mod tidy.
microSteps: Implement main.go run() function: load config, setup slog (JSON for prod, text for dev), connect pgx pool with config.DatabaseURL, create CompositePublisher, build chi router with middleware chain + health endpoint, create server, handle SIGTERM for graceful shutdown
Run go mod tidy to resolve all dependencies and generate go.sum

tdd.reason: Composition root — wiring code. Verified by successful compilation and go vet. Integration test would require running PostgreSQL.
